entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor WASM diagnostics feature switches never default on (BlazorWasmDiagnosticsEnabled vs BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled property mismatch) #55446
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.MobileHotReloadTests.HotReload_WithWebSocketCapability: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55430
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55424

Closed

  • OCI Metadata Labels Broken When Using Hyperlinks #52732
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #55423

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix Blazor WebAssembly diagnostics defaults to use the defined opt-out property #55447
  • Modify network isolation policy in CI configuration to Permissive in PRs #55445
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Update Windows SDK projections #55444
  • Add copilot-app LLM environment telemetry detection [10.0.4xx] #55443
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55441
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview7] Fix multi-arch container label parsing #55437
    backport
  • Honor Configuration environment variable in CLI options #55431
    Area-dotnet test, Area-CLI, cli-ux
  • Fix flaky It_generates_satellite_assemblies by decoding captured test stdout as UTF-8 #55428
  • Share SDK resolution during Pack and Publish discovery #55426
    Area-CLI, cli-ux, Area-MSBuild
  • Host the Razor source generator in rzc (opt-in generate/discover) #55422

Merged

  • Add telemetry for --help, --version, and --info options #55442
  • Add copilot-app LLM environment telemetry detection #55440
  • Disable packing of Microsoft.Dotnet.Installation #55439
  • Fix ValidatePatternBaseDir for wildcard-in-directory-name patterns #55433
  • Fixed a lot of typos in the codebase and documentation #55327
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Fix multi-arch container label parsing #55414
    Area-Containers, 11.0.1xx
  • Add PartitionByClass support to Helix test scheduling #55434
  • Fix dotnetup CI builds #55435
  • [main] Fix Native AOT SDK version lookup #55413
    auto-merge, backport
  • Document multi-repo ownership boundaries #55432
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26367.7 to 4.4.0-preview.26372.14 #55425
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Add MTP artifact post-processing to dotnet test #55419
  • Add test authoring guidance for Helix compatibility and TFM properties #55388
  • Normalize SDK build leg naming #55400
  • Forward MSBuild build/tasks/details telemetry event #54092
  • Add deep-nested traversal e2e tests for dotnet test (MTP) #55407
  • Bump minimum MSBuild version to 18.7 #55230

Updated

  • Migrate to custom OTel Exporter in `dotnetup` to prevent perf delay and data loss #55421
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to MSTest/Helix #55399
  • Add --allow-prerelease and --no-sdk-version options to dotnet new globaljson template #54133
  • Scope .editorconfig discovery to included files in dotnet format folder mode #55248
  • Simplify MacAddressGetter to use NetworkInterface API directly #55420
  • Add `dotnetup` `preview` `release-strategy-plan.md` #54735
  • Better error when workload set version uses package version format #54929
    Area-CLI, Area-Workloads
  • Suppress advertising manifest messages unless verbosity is diagnostic #55276
  • Add OCI container annotation support #55415
    Area-Containers
  • Enable live output for MSTest tests #55418
  • Fix issues from container build digest code review #55322
  • Resolve analyzers from the analyzers group in project.assets.json #54646
  • Added fixer for CA1848: Use the LoggerMessage delegates #52622
    Area-Infrastructure, stale
  • Backport MTP handshake failure diagnostics #55377
    Servicing-consider
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • Run wasm test hosts standalone under `dotnet test` (MTP) #55389
